title: Five Discourses on Not Scrutinizing Form, Etc.
html:
• Saṁyutta Nikāya 33.46–50 Linked Discourses 33.46–50
  • 1. Vacchagottavagga 1. With Vacchagotta

Rūpaappaccupekkhaṇādisuttapañcaka Five Discourses on Not Scrutinizing Form, Etc.

Sāvatthinidānaṁ. At Sāvatthī.

“Rūpe kho, vaccha, appaccupekkhaṇā …pe… viññāṇe kho, vaccha, appaccupekkhaṇā …pe…. “Vaccha, it is because of not scrutinizing form …”

Paññāsamaṁ.
